plugins.name: amazon-selling-partner
plugins.description: Connect your Amazon Seller Central account to Claude. Ask about sales, inventory, and listing performance and get recommendations grounded in your own data, not generic advice. Review and approve every action, without switching back to Seller Central. Currently in beta.

skills.name: fba-inbound-management
skills.description: Guides a seller end-to-end through sending inventory to Amazon''s fulfillment network: creating an inbound plan, packing, placement, transportation, delivery windows, and shipment confirmation — plus status checks, modifications, and cancellation. Drives the sequential CREATE→PACK→PLACE→TRANSPORT→DELIVER→SHIP pipeline, polls async operations to completion, and pauses at every decision gate for the seller''s choice. Triggers on: send inventory to Amazon, create inbound plan, ship to FBA, inbound shipment status, cancel inbound plan, add tracking, FNSKU labels, prep requirements, schedule FC drop-off. Do NOT use for: stockout / replenishment forecasting (use stockout-prevention), listing issues, advertising, or orders.
headings: The async pattern (do this after EVERY write)
Workflow (Pipeline + Inversion — sequential, ask at every gate)
Step 4 — Placement option (PERMANENT, fee-charging — HARD GATE)
skills.description_zh: 逐步指导将库存送入 Amazon FBA：建立入库计划、打包、分仓、运输、送达窗口及确认发货，也处理状态、修改、取消、跟踪、FNSKU 标签和预处理要求。按 CREATE→PACK→PLACE→TRANSPORT→DELIVER→SHIP 顺序等待异步完成，每个决策门由卖家选择；不用于缺货预测、商品问题、广告或订单。

skills.name: invite-secondary-users
skills.description: Helps the account owner, an administrator, or a permissions manager of a Seller Central account invite their secondary users to use the Selling Partner plugin. Runs right after the Amazon Selling Partner Connector connector is connected: it confirms the person can grant agent access, asks whether they want to invite secondary users, then walks them through Manage Your Permissions -> Manage Agents, where they enable the agent for the account and choose which secondary users may authorize it. When the skill runs in Amazon Quick, it adds one extra step — inviting that user as a collaborator in the Quick account. Triggers on: invite users, add a secondary user, manage agents, grant agent access, "let my team use the plugin", onboard my team, give access to another user. Do NOT use for: setting up your own account/marketplace (established by the connect flow), taking selling actions, or User Permissions unrelated to AI agents.
headings: Workflow (confirm role -> offer -> guide the grant -> Quick-only collaborator)
Step 1 — Confirm the connector is connected, then confirm the role
Step 2 — Offer to invite secondary users
Step 3 — Guide the Manage Agents grant (Seller Central)
Step 4 — Quick ONLY: invite the user as a Quick collaborator
Step 5 — Summarize what's granted and what's left to the user
skills.description_zh: 帮助 Seller Central 账户所有者、管理员或权限管理员邀请次级用户使用 Selling Partner 插件。连接后先确认授予智能体权限的资格并询问是否邀请，再指导在 Manage Your Permissions → Manage Agents 启用并选择可授权用户；在 Amazon Quick 还需邀请该用户为协作者。不用于自身账户或市场配置、销售操作及无关智能体的权限。

skills.name: listing-buyability
skills.description: Diagnoses why a seller''s listing isn''t buyable and relays the specific reason plus the next step. Checks the three things that make a listing buyable — a complete product, a valid purchasable offer, and available inventory — then fixes the offer (preview → approve) or routes inventory elsewhere. Triggers on: not buyable, can''t be purchased, "why can''t customers buy this", no buy box, listing inactive, missing price / offer. Do NOT use for: search/discoverability (use listing-searchability), fixing reported listing issues (use listing-issues), or inventory replenishment (use stockout-prevention).
headings: Workflow (diagnose the cause, then relay or fix)
Step 2 — Find the cause (in this order)
Step 3 — Whose data is it? (framing for product-data fixes)
Step 3b — Compliance gate (before a condition or product-data change)
Step 4 — Fix the offer (preview → approve → verify)
skills.description_zh: 诊断商品无法购买的原因，检查产品完整性、有效可购买报价及可用库存，说明原因与下一步；报价修复须先预览后批准，库存问题转交对应流程。用于无法购买、无购买框、未激活或缺价格报价；不用于搜索发现、已报告商品错误或补货预测。

skills.name: listing-compliance
skills.description: Pre-flight compliance gate before any listing write. Identifies which Amazon listing and regulatory requirements (FDA, EPA, CPSC, FCC, FTC, disclosures, GTIN, category gating) apply, asks the seller once for the facts only they know, checks account-side gating, and holds the write until the seller gives an explicit go. Triggers on: "can I list this", "what do I need to sell X", "is this compliant", listing requirements, help me list, or when a sibling listing skill is about to change product claims, ingredients, category, condition, images, or identifiers. Do NOT use for: reported issues (listing-issues), buyability (listing-buyability), search optimization (listing-searchability), or general program-policy Q&A unrelated to listings.
headings: Workflow (classify → rule out cheaply → ask once → confirm only if needed → hold for go)
Step 1 — Establish account context (reuse, don't re-ask)
Step 2 — Classify the product (be inclusive, read only what applies)
Step 3 — Prohibited? Stop once, before spending anything
Step 4 — Check account-side gating (one fast read)
Step 5 — Ask once, grouped, only what's relevant
Step 6 — Confirm current rules via Seller Assistant *(only when it changes the answer)*
Step 7 — Present the checklist and get an explicit go
Step 8 — Hand back to the owning skill
skills.description_zh: 在商品写入前识别适用 Amazon 上架及 FDA、EPA、CPSC、FCC、FTC、披露、GTIN 和类别准入要求，一次询问只有卖家知道的事实，核查账户准入，并等卖家明确同意后才写入。用于上架合规及修改声明、成分、类别、状态、图片或标识符前；不用于已报告问题、可购买性、搜索优化或无关上架的一般政策问答。

skills.name: listing-issues
skills.description: Fixes listing problems that surface as reported issues on a listing — missing or invalid attributes, and suppressions tied to an issue. Reads the listing''s issues (severity + enforcement), prioritizes by impact, and previews every fix before it goes live. Triggers on: listing issues, listing errors, fix my listing, attribute errors, suppressed because of an issue, "what''s wrong with this listing". Do NOT use for: why a listing isn''t buyable when there''s no issue (use listing-buyability), search visibility / optimization (use listing-searchability), creating new listings, inventory / stockout, advertising, or orders.
headings: Workflow (Reviewer + Inversion — diagnose, then ask before fixing)
Step 2 — Read status as context (issues are what this skill acts on)
Step 4b — Compliance gate (before any compliance-sensitive fix)
Step 5 — Draft the fix (DO NOT EXECUTE without approval)
Sibling skills (route to these when there's no issue to fix)
skills.description_zh: 读取商品已报告问题的严重度和执行措施，按影响排序修复缺失或无效属性及问题导致的屏蔽，每项上线前均先预览。用于商品错误、属性错误或因问题被抑制；不用于无报告问题的不可购买、搜索优化、新建商品、库存缺货、广告或订单。

skills.name: listing-searchability
skills.description: Diagnoses why a seller''s listing isn''t found in search and helps make it more discoverable. Checks whether the listing is discoverable at all, then optimizes the content shoppers search on — title, description, bullet points, and generic keywords — with the seller''s approval. Triggers on: not showing up in search, can''t be found, not discoverable, improve ranking, search visibility, optimize my listing, SEO. Do NOT use for: not-buyable (use listing-buyability) or fixing reported issues (use listing-issues).
skills.description_zh: 诊断商品搜索不可见，先检查能否被发现，再经卖家批准优化标题、描述、要点和通用关键词。用于搜索找不到、排名及可发现性优化；不用于无法购买或已报告问题修复。

skills.name: listing-troubleshooter
skills.description: Top-level entry point for any "something''s wrong with my listing" question. Does a quick scan to read the listing''s status and issues, identifies the symptom, and routes the seller to the right specialist skill — issue-fixing, buyability, searchability, or compliance. Triggers on: something''s wrong with my listing, troubleshoot my listing, my product has a problem, listing not working, where do I start, "can I list this", "what do I need to sell X". Routes to: listing-issues, listing-buyability, listing-searchability, listing-compliance.
headings: Step 1 — Quick scan *(skip when there's nothing to scan yet)*
Step 2 — Classify the symptom and route
skills.description_zh: 商品异常的总入口：快速读取状态和问题，识别症状并转交 listing-issues、listing-buyability、listing-searchability 或 listing-compliance，适用于不知从何排查、产品异常及上架要求问题。

skills.name: seller-analytics
skills.description: Answers a seller''s business-performance questions — inventory health, traffic, and sales — by querying the Amazon Selling Partner Connector analytics tools. Always discovers the real metric IDs first (never guesses metric names), then retrieves the data with the correct filters, grouping, and time range, and explains the result in plain language. Read-only: it reports numbers, it never changes anything. Triggers on: "how are my sales / sessions / traffic", "am I at risk of a stockout", "how much inventory do I have", "what''s my days of supply", "show me page views by ASIN", "when should I restock", "seller analytics", "business report". Do NOT use for: changing prices or listings, creating shipments, tax/GST/financial-settlement reports, or establishing which account/marketplace to use (established by the connect flow).
headings: Step 1 — Establish account context (reuse, don't re-ask)
Step 2 — Discover the right metric (never guess)
Step 4 — Handle pagination and empty results
skills.description_zh: 只读查询 Amazon Selling Partner Connector 分析工具，回答库存健康、流量和销售表现。先发现真实指标 ID，不猜名称，再按正确过滤、分组和时间取数并通俗解释。用于销量、访问、缺货风险、库存、可供天数、ASIN 浏览量和补货时点；不用于价格或商品修改、建货运、税务或结算报告，也不决定连接流程已确定的账户或市场。

skills.name: sp-api-knowledge
skills.description: Answers Selling Partner API (SP-API) questions and guides developers from idea to working code, grounded strictly in the SP-API documentation knowledge base, never from general knowledge or web guesses. Searches the docs first, fetches full content, routes by question shape (factual lookup, how it works, getting started, which API to use, does-X-support, build an integration, design a solution), and pairs every answer with a visual such as a mermaid diagram, a table, or a design-proposal artifact when brainstorming. Read-only: it explains and designs, it never changes a seller account. Use for SP-API developer questions: how do I, which SP-API to use, does SP-API support X, rate limits, error codes, auth, getting started, build an integration, design or brainstorm, show me a schema or workflow, across Orders, Feeds, Listings, FBA, Reports, Notifications, Catalog, Pricing, and Vendor. Do NOT use for account actions (price, listing, inventory, shipment changes), live account analytics, or non-SP-API topics.
headings: Step 0: Ground everything (the rule that overrides all others)
Step 0.5: Stay responsive (answer in one pass; don't over-orchestrate)
Step 1: Classify the question, then route
Step 2: Search well, and call the **fewest tools** that answer it
Step 3: Answer, then show it (every turn includes a rendered diagram)
Step 4: Design / brainstorm path -> produce a proposal artifact
Step 6: Cite, and be honest about gaps
skills.description_zh: 严格依据 SP-API 文档知识库解答开发问题并指导从构想到代码：先搜索并读取全文，按事实、原理、入门、API 选择、能力支持或集成设计路由，并配图表或设计产物。覆盖 Orders、Feeds、Listings、FBA、Reports、Notifications、Catalog、Pricing 和 Vendor；只解释设计，不改卖家账户，不用于账户操作、实时经营分析或非 SP-API 主题。

skills.name: stockout-prevention
skills.description: Monitors FBA inventory health, identifies stockout risks from sales velocity, and orchestrates prevention actions — primarily inbound-shipment gap analysis and restocking. Triggers on: inventory check, stockout risk, FBA stock levels, days of cover, days of supply, replenishment, "am I going to run out". Do NOT use for: catalog management, new product listings, advertising, or order fulfillment.
headings: Step 3b — Visualize the risk (render a chart artifact)
Step 4 — Check the inbound pipeline (only for flagged SKUs)
Step 4b — Visualize the gap (render a timeline artifact)
Step 5 — Recommend options (for CRITICAL SKUs with a gap)
Step 6 — Draft actions (DO NOT EXECUTE without approval)
skills.description_zh: 监控 FBA 库存健康，根据销售速度识别缺货风险并协调防范，重点为入库货运缺口分析和补货。用于库存检查、可供天数及补货；不用于目录管理、新产品上架、广告或履约。

skills.name: support-case-helper
skills.description: Guides an Amazon seller (Seller Central) who has a Selling Partner account or selling issue to the right Amazon support path. It gathers a few case details, assembles a clean, PII-free summary, and either (a) uses an Amazon Selling Partner connector tool to contact Seller Support / create a case when such a tool is available and the seller explicitly confirms, or (b) — when no such tool exists — points the seller to the Seller Central Help Center to open the case themselves. Triggers on: "I need to contact Amazon about my account", "How do I open a support case?", "Something''s wrong with my account and I need help", "I need additional help with Amazon", "can you open a case", "contact Amazon support", "connect me with Amazon support". Do NOT use for: Vendors (Vendor Central) or any non–Seller Central use case; requests that are not Amazon Seller / Selling Partner support; diagnosing or fixing the underlying problem; or submitting a case without the seller''s explicit confirmation.
headings: Step 3 — Choose the support path (tool-aware, future-proof)
Step 4 — Write the summary as a short human message
skills.description_zh: 为 Seller Central 卖家账户或销售问题整理少量案情及去除个人信息的摘要，指引正确 Amazon 支持路径。有支持工具且卖家明确确认时可联系或建案例，否则引导用户自行到帮助中心提交。不用于 Vendor Central、非卖家支持、根因诊断修复或未经明确确认提交。
